verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a professional legal-services firm, not a software platform, so scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence describes only legal practice areas. Its mention of a "high-efficiency workflow" refers to the firm's internal practice model, not a user-facing scheduling capability. The 404 probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI confirm there is no software interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
